headline: Aniimo catching tips
title: Aniimo Catching Tips | How To Catch Aniimo Easily | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Stop wasting Aniipods in Aniimo! Tip one: sneak up and throw from behind for a backstab bonus. Tip two: sleeping and unaware Aniimo are easier to catch. Tip three: fill the Break gauge in battle first, a staggered Aniimo is much easier to catch. Tip four: hover your crosshair to see the catch chance before you throw. And tip five: missed Aniipods come back to you, so keep trying! Save this for later!
description: Aniimo catching tips: throw from behind for a backstab bonus, target sleeping or unaware Aniimo, fill the Break gauge first, hover your crosshair to see the catch chance, and missed Aniipods are returned to you.
